direction.camera: Guide attention with ink silhouette; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: build the reveal around one diagonal blade-like composition; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with sharp diagonal; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with quiet tension.
direction.lighting: stark side key; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: ink wash and worn steel; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around brush texture; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use ink silhouette,sharp diagonal,red seal,measured strike,brush texture,quiet tension as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
